acceptance_checks: A test driving mergegate_check.main() with the metadata job's exact argv against a valid post_merge_reconcile fixture returns ready (today it blocks).
The same test with --base-shiki removed still blocks (fail-closed behavior unchanged).
Simulating the commit-evidence step where only new files are created produces a commit and a push (today it reports no changes and exits 0).
A command-substitution payload in a comment body reaches the plan-file argument as a literal string, creates no file, and fails with the script's own missing-file error.
validate_shiki fails when either flag is removed from the metadata job, and fails when an expression is reintroduced into any run: body.
non_goals: Replacing GITHUB_TOKEN for the evidence PR (operator decision)
scope: In .github/workflows/shiki-mergegate.yml build a base .shiki snapshot in Prepare PR context and pass --base-shiki and --merged-prs to the metadata check, mirroring the CCA workflow, so post_merge_reconcile PRs can actually pass. In .github/workflows/shiki-orchestrator.yml stage before the guard (git add .shiki then git diff --cached --quiet) so newly created untracked evidence is not silently discarded, and pass comment- and input-derived values through env: instead of splicing GitHub expressions into run: bodies. Extend validate_shiki so the workflow contract asserts the invocation (required flags per job, and no expression interpolation inside a run: body), not just the presence of strings.
test_command: bash scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_run_orchestrator.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_workflow_lint.sh && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
title: Make workflows invoke the scripts they claim to, and assert it
